items.name: Assign website leads
items.description: A lead from the website form is given an owner using the assignment rules, then the round robin.
items.trigger: A website form submission is accepted.
items.effect: Sets the owner of the new lead. Off: the lead is left unassigned for someone to take.

items.name: Follow-up task on a new website lead
items.description: The owner of a new website lead gets a task to acknowledge and qualify it.
items.trigger: A website lead is created with an owner.
items.effect: Creates one task for the owner, due after the number of hours set.

items.name: Proposal follow-up
items.description: A proposal that has had no answer for a while reminds the person who owns it.
items.trigger: A sent proposal has not been touched for the number of days set.
items.effect: Notifies the owner. Never changes the proposal or the deal.

default.boundary: Automations assign, remind and draft. They never move a deal stage, set a discount, approve anything or change an owner outside an assignment rule.

reports.title: Lead sources
reports.definition: Leads created in the date range, counted by the source they came from. A lead with no source is counted as No source.

reports.title: Conversion by source
reports.definition: Of the leads created in the date range, how many have become a deal as of today, by source. Conversion is converted divided by created, shown as 0% when no leads were created.

reports.title: Conversion by lead stage
reports.definition: Of the leads created in the date range, how many sit at each lead status now, and how many of those have become a deal. Conversion is converted divided by leads at that status.
